Docs.summary: Provides device controls that an application publishes to the Android system interface.

remarks.para: Implement to supply controls and handle user actions. Use for discovery and suggestions, and for current-state updates. Publishers must respect subscription demand. Send action response codes through the supplied consumer and publish visible state changes separately. Controls require device unlock by default; disabling this requirement does not override the user setting for actions on a locked device. Supply an activity pending intent for interactions beyond the control template.
